The reference image for Anthracnose shows a reddish-brown, damaged leaf with holes and irregular edges, which does not closely match the dark, somewhat circular spots seen on the green leaf in the test image. This suggests the test image might not be Anthracnose. I will now view a reference image for another class. I will choose "Sooty_Mould" next as it often presents with dark, superficial growth on leaves.
